race.description: Jack Lindley Memorial Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: TOMMY FLYER (3) pulled up with a slow recovery rate when a tiring ninth over 1400m at Bathurst. Assess on earlier runs and anywhere his best can win this. BRASS MONKEYS (6) is holding his form and like the way he closed off to run fourth over 1200m at Bathurst. Placed at this track and trip and looks to have genuine top-three claims. BOURBON QUEEN (8) defeated a good line-up here two back over this trip, then she failed to run the 1650m out with a battling sixth over at Moruya. Poorly drawn but can run into the minor money. BIG OPINION (1) is ready for this trip now and worth a look. SUNDROP (10) next best.
